reviewTitle: Excellent quality and durability!!! (Great for small ears)
reviewDescription: Excellent quality for the price!! I purchased these back in 2022 and I only had to replace them in 2026 because I’m clumsy and drop the case a lot. They have excellent noise cancellation and pretty decent sound quality for the price. I also have pretty small ears (I can’t use most earbuds because they fall out/hurt my ears) and with the xs tips they fit perfectly. The battery life is amazing I only have to charge them at most once a month and i use them almost every day for at least 2-3 hours. They survived being run through the washer in the pocket of my jeans on two separate occasions, left in a car over night in triple digit heat multiple times, and years of abuse/wear & tear and the only problem is now I have trouble getting it to start charging back in the case and the lid is broken.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on August 21, 2026
